screen: #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/evidence/summary (full); same tile on every run's Summary
title: The Summary tile 'Calculations 59 - Each one traceable to its inputs' counts traced items, not calculations: 58 of the 59 Trace rows open no derivation.
expected: CM-074 and CM-078: Summary states what can be verified and how; Trace rows with a calculation expand as a derivation with exact operands. D-15: figures are exact and labelled, none misdescribed.
actual: Summary draws the delivered metric 'Calculations 59' with the note 'Each one traceable to its inputs'. The Trace tab holds 59 rows (Passage 23, Figure 17, Row 13, Chart 6) and only T-0014 has a derivation (one 'Show how ... was derived' control on screen). The Trace card also says 'Open a row to see how it was derived'. The reader is told 59 calculations are traceable to their inputs; one is. web/src/pages/library/read.ts does not tie the tile to the rows with calc. Record's 'Calculation register' lists 148 rows for the same run, a third figure for the same thing.
suggested_change: Count the rows that carry a derivation for the tile (or relabel it 'Traced items') and drop 'Each one traceable to its inputs' unless every row opens a derivation; have read.ts refuse a tile that disagrees with the rows.

screen: Trace drawer opened from #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/overview (and every run page); Evidence trace rows
title: 57 of the 58 trace drawers list no source, file, page or quoted passage, while the matching Evidence Trace row reports 'Sources 1' to '6'.
expected: CM-008 and CM-079: the drawer lists the figure's own source file, page, quoted passage and calculation steps; D-06: Evidence lists every reference, none dropped.
actual: Drawer for 'Revenue USD 2,105m' shows only the statement and 'Result  Revenue 2,105'; its Trace row T-0021 says Sources 4. Same for the bottom line (row T-0001, Sources 6), T-0015, T-0016, T-0023 and 53 more. Only net leverage (T-0014) carries sources and an excerpt. The reader cannot reach any of the sources the Trace tab counts.
suggested_change: Deliver each trace's sources (files, pages, excerpts) in the derivation, or draw a stated gap in the drawer when a row's Sources count is above zero and none is delivered; have the reader refuse the disagreement.

title: 'Download handoffs', 'Download all' and every register 'Open' point at files that are not in the built app; clicking Download handoffs replaces the page with the browser's file-not-found page.
expected: CT-048 and CM-018: downloads are the stored bytes of the handoffs, registers and calculation JSON, and each link opens or saves a file.
actual: All six hrefs (downloads/halden-aerostructures-2026-09-30-handoffs.zip, ...-registers.zip, ...-registers/{sources,calculations,gaps,assumptions}.md) resolve beside index.html to nothing. Clicking Download handoffs navigates the main frame to chrome-error://chromewebdata/ (ERR_FILE_NOT_FOUND), losing the page; the 'Open' links open a blank error tab. No file exists under web/dist, web/public or web/fixtures. The link is a plain anchor with the download attribute and no check. Scope: the fixture build only; the shipped build holds no Evidence data, so this is Medium, not High.
suggested_change: Ship the sample downloads with the fixture build, or have the fixture deliver href null with the reason sentence so the disabled form is drawn; a missing file must not replace the app.

title: After Enter on an Evidence tab link (Summary, Trace, Sources, Gaps, Record) keyboard focus drops to the document body.
expected: D-38 and D-35: focus goes somewhere sensible after an activation; a keyboard user is not sent back to the start of the page.
actual: Tab to 'Trace 59', press Enter: the address changes and document.activeElement is <body>. The next Tab starts again at 'Skip to content', 25 stops before the Evidence tabs. The same happens by mouse. EvidenceFrame is remounted per tab (Evidence.tsx renders a different tree and key for each page) so the clicked link is destroyed.
suggested_change: Keep the frame mounted across Evidence tabs (key only the body), or move focus to the tab panel heading after a tab change.

screen: #/library/halden-aerostructures/2026-09-30/evidence/trace and /sources with a module chosen that holds no rows (empty state, keyboard)
title: Activating 'Show all items' or 'Show all files' in the empty state sends focus to the document body.
expected: D-38: when the focused control goes away, focus moves to a named place (the module filter or the table).
actual: Choose Forecast on Trace (or Recovery on Sources), Tab to the clear button, press Enter: the filter is cleared and document.activeElement is <body>. The button was removed with the empty state.
suggested_change: Return focus to the Module filter button when the clear action runs.

title: The module filter is drawn on three of the five Evidence tabs and resets to 'All' on every tab change.
expected: CM-072 and CT-046: 'one module filter applies to all five tabs'.
actual: Summary and Record draw no filter. On Trace choose Capital structure, open Gaps: the filter reads 'Module: All'. The filter state lives in FilteredTab, which Evidence.tsx re-keys per tab. The user can decide less than the control row says.
suggested_change: Hold the chosen module above the five tabs (in the frame) and apply it to Summary counts and Record rows, or amend the matrix rows to say three tabs and per tab (owner's choice).

title: At 390 px the Gaps, Trace and Registers tables scroll sideways inside their card with no cue: 'Effect on the view' and 'Shown as' are off screen, and 'Recovery', 'Peer comparison' and 'Financial performance' break mid-word.
expected: D-42 and D-32: content reflows without loss; a qualification is never cut; judged at 390 px (stage-2 brief, check 2).
actual: Region scroll width against client width at 390: Gaps 695/324, Trace 521/324, Registers 411/324. In Gaps the first screen shows Gap, What is missing and a Module column that reads 'Recover / y'; the effect-on-the-view sentence and the link to the finding sit past the card edge. The code comment says the table 'wraps to the page width, so there is nothing to scroll to'; with overflow-wrap:anywhere it does not.
suggested_change: Stack each row as a card below the small breakpoint (the reason sentence first), or fix column widths so no word breaks and add a visible scroll cue.

title: The Model calls table on Record shows a 'Code' column of module codes (CP-1A, CP-2C, CP-3B, CP-2E) beside each module's name.
expected: D-13 part 1 and R-13: no module code as a label on any page, Evidence included (Amendment 2026-11-12); EvidenceRecord.tsx's own comment says codes 'appear only here'. Harmony H-09 reads the amendments as allowing codes only inside module-written text. Owner to rule.
actual: Column 'Code' lists CP-1A for Business profile, CP-2C for Capital structure, CP-3B for Recovery, CP-2E for Peer comparison. The page's own column is a label, not module-written text. The pairs also disagree with content-matrix rows (CP-1A is the governance module in CM-134; CP-2E is the ESG module in CM-261).
suggested_change: Remove the Code column or show the plain module name only; if the owner keeps codes on Record, fix the fixture mapping and record the ruling.

title: Record's Model calls table lists four of thirteen modules but its Total row (41 calls, 6 retries, USD 11.40) does not say so; Module timings lists six of thirteen with no way to see the rest.
expected: CM-117, CM-204, CM-205: actual module states, spend and retries for the run; D-31: a partial state is designed and says what is missing.
actual: Rows sum to 14 calls, 2 retries and USD 3.38 against the Total row's 41, 6 and 11.40, with no note; tokens in the Total row read n.a. The timings note says 'Six of thirteen shown' and offers no control for the other seven. A reader who adds the rows finds a mismatch with no explanation.
suggested_change: Say 'Four of thirteen modules shown' on Model calls, and add 'Show all modules' (or draw all rows) on both tables.

title: Sources lists name, type, size, state and readers but no document date, and does not separate files supplied but not used from files read.
expected: CM-073: 'file name, type, document date, modules that read each' and, separately, files supplied but not used.
actual: Each row shows e.g. 'PDF annual-report-2026.pdf 8.4 MB - 214 pages - Read in full', 'Read by 11 modules' and a hash; the SourceFile type has no date field. The file nobody read ('Read by 0 modules') sits in the same list in delivered order.
suggested_change: Add a document-date field to SourceFile and the row; group files with no reader under 'Supplied but not used'.

title: Record draws no register tables, no confidence-inputs table, no delivery or publication state, no calculation JSON download and no per-module handoff download; its 'Registers as written' is a list of file links.
expected: CM-018, CM-069, CM-076, CM-080, CM-092 and the per-module register rows CM-212, 221, 235, 246, 253, 261, 269, 276, 284, 295, 303, 311 (R13 RegisterTable with exact trace on Evidence > Record); CM-216 and the other confidence-inputs rows.
actual: Record holds Module timings, Hashes, Spend, Model calls and Registers as written (name, written by, row count, file, Open). No register row, no confidence inputs, no 'delivered / published' state, no calculation JSON, no 'one download per module'; the only handoff download is one zip on Summary. Matrix rows are marked in harmony.csv. The static design may have chosen file links on purpose (decision 9); the matrix says otherwise.
suggested_change: Owner to confirm whether the static Record draws registers and confidence inputs or links to files; then either draw them or amend the matrix rows.

title: Evidence shows nothing of the comparison with an earlier run: no reason for 'not compared', no regression or recheck register, no comparison measures, no CP-8 Basis form.
expected: CM-051 (the service's reason is drawn only on Evidence), CM-059 and CM-199 (regressions and recheck on Evidence > Gaps), CM-114 and CM-198 (Evidence owns comparison measures and sources), CM-063 (Basis reads 'Run comparison').
actual: Gaps lists the run's own gaps by severity only; Summary and Record carry no comparison block; no drawer in the fixture reads 'Run comparison' or '<module>, earlier run'. Whether Changes carries the narrative is S2's check.
suggested_change: Add a comparison section to Evidence (reason, regressions, recheck, comparison measures) or record that the static library leaves it to Changes.

title: With the shipped data file (no issuers) every Evidence address shows only 'Evidence / This data file holds no library pages'.
expected: D-31: empty is the UUI empty state with a featured icon, title, one sentence and the next action.
actual: A plain paragraph under an h1, no icon, no link to the library or to starting a run. Same text on all eight Evidence addresses.
suggested_change: Draw the EmptyState used elsewhere (Absent) with a way back.

title: One invalid field in the data blanks every library page and prints a dotted data path to the reader.
expected: D-31: no raw error string; an error is an alert with an action.
actual: A fixture copy with files[4].why null shows 'This part of the library could not be read / issuers[0].runs[0].evidence.sources.files[4].why: expected the reason an unreadable file gives' on Evidence and on Overview. Page code is S1's (App.tsx:67-75).
suggested_change: Show a titled alert in the reader's words and keep the path under a disclosure.

title: The loading skeleton on Evidence is the Overview-shaped placeholder (banner and metric cards) and is not announced.
expected: D-31: a static skeleton in the shape of what will arrive; D-43: status changes are announced.
actual: No Evidence heading, tab strip or table shape; the container has aria-busy='true', no text and no status region.
suggested_change: Draw a skeleton that matches the Evidence frame and give it a visually hidden 'Loading' status.

screen: All five Evidence tabs and the drawer (full)
title: Text smaller than 13 px is drawn in S4's own parts: table heads, sort buttons, 'Run code' captions, 'Read by N modules', file-type tiles, kind badges and the shortcut key.
expected: D-30: no text under 13 px; .impeccable/config.json ignores tiny-text only for docs/design/mockups/module-report.html.
actual: Computed font size 12 px for the table heads and sort buttons (RegisterTable HEAD), Snippet caption, SourceFileRow type tile and reader label, JumpMenu shortcut key and drawer captions.
suggested_change: Raise these to text-sm (13/14 px).

title: At 390 px the copy toast touches the left edge and covers the bottom navigation.
expected: D-26: sibling screens agree on spacing; the toast is a small non-blocking confirmation.
actual: Toast rect 0,712 to 358,812; the Areas bar spans 783 to 845, so the toast hides its labels for four seconds. right-8 is set but no left margin.
suggested_change: Set left and bottom offsets that clear the mobile bar (bottom above 5rem, left-4).

title: The jump search matches labels only, so an id the row itself shows (T-0014, G-03, C-0412) finds nothing; at 390 px ids break across lines and the Ctrl K hint is drawn on a touch layout.
expected: The command menu lists 'Capital structure · T-0014' as the row's detail; typing the id should reach the row.
actual: Typing T-0014 gives 'No item matches' although the first option's detail reads T-0014. At 390 px 'T-0104' wraps to 'T- / 0104'. EvidenceJump.test.tsx asserts label-only matching on purpose.
suggested_change: Match the label and the detail; keep ids unbroken (whitespace-nowrap).

title: The page-level 'Show sources' switch is drawn above every Evidence tab, but Evidence has no trace control for it to show.
expected: D-06: the switch reveals the trace controls of a page; control-matrix rows list no switch for Evidence.
actual: Zero 'Show sources for ...' buttons on the five tabs, so toggling the switch changes nothing. The switch comes from RunFrame (S2).
suggested_change: Hide the switch on Evidence pages.

title: The document title is 'Credit OS' on every Evidence address, with no page, tab or issuer name.
expected: WCAG 2.4.2 page titled; the route table gives each library route a title.
actual: document.title reads 'Credit OS' on Summary, Trace, Gaps and the Overview; the title in web/src/pages/library/routes.tsx is used only for the visible h1 (App.tsx).
suggested_change: Set document.title from the route title and the issuer (S1 owns App.tsx).

title: The trace drawer has two buttons named 'Close' that do the same thing.
expected: D-37: every control has a name; two controls of one name that act alike are one control.
actual: The slide-out's corner X (aria-label Close) and the footer Close button are both announced 'Close'.
suggested_change: Drop the footer Close or name it 'Close sources'.

title: TraceControl and JumpMenu throw RangeError for states read.ts already refuses; the app has no error boundary, so reaching one would blank the app.
expected: Stage-2 brief check 5: a catch-all must not hide a failure, and an unreachable branch is noted.
actual: TraceControl.tsx:30 throws for a trace key the run lacks; JumpMenu.tsx:81 throws inside an event handler for an unknown item. itemsHeld() in read.ts refuses both beforehand, so no input reaches them.
suggested_change: Keep: the throws guard a contract; stage 6 may drop the unreachable branches.

title: The two register pages repeat the same block (landed ref and scroll-and-focus effect, 'No ... has this address' alert, filter empty state, sort state), and `columns.value` and `TraceRow.value` are read and never drawn.
expected: Stage-2 brief check 5: duplicated blocks; state set and never read.
actual: EvidenceTrace.tsx:40-62 and EvidenceGaps.tsx:53-74 are near copies; slice.ts:510 and read.ts:1657 carry a 'value' head and row value that no page draws (kept for a fixture test, per the type comment).
suggested_change: Extract a useLandedRow hook and an UnknownAddress component for stage 6.

title: Stage 0's inventory seeded 58 Evidence addresses from drawer keys (trace/bottom-line, trace/net-leverage, ...) that are not Evidence item ids, so each opens the 'No item has this address' state.
expected: Stage-0 brief: visit each address the app can reach; an item address is a Trace row id such as T-0014 (EvidenceTrace.tsx item prop; TraceDrawer evidenceHref uses trace.evidenceItem).
actual: 3,016 of the 4,131 S4 inventory lines sit on trace/<drawer key> addresses (crawl.mjs:73 appends Object.keys(latest.traces)); each draws the warning and the whole table. They are the same controls as /evidence/trace. Real item addresses (T-0014, T-0042, T-9999) are 3 of the 58+.
suggested_change: Seed Evidence item addresses from the Trace rows' ids (and gap ids), not from the drawer keys.

title: Three control-matrix rows (CT-036, CT-041, CT-049) describe orchestration and delivery behaviour that no static Evidence screen draws or lets the user operate, so nothing on S4's screens can show them met or unmet.
expected: Stage-2 brief check 4: for each control-matrix row, check the user can decide exactly what the row says; CT-036, CT-041 and CT-049 are 'Not a user control' rows.
actual: CT-036 (retry of a refused module draft: events appear on Run activity and Evidence > Record), CT-041 (delivery and library admission) and CT-049 (method and revision per module) have no counterpart on the five Evidence tabs: Record shows retries as a count column in Model calls only, no draft-rejection events, no method revision and no admission state. Nothing is wrong beyond the matrix naming Evidence > Record for CT-036 and the pages for CT-041, which the static fixture cannot demonstrate; marked 'not reachable here' in harmony.csv.
suggested_change: none: the owner (or stage 4) rules whether the static Record should draw draft-rejection events and the method revision, or the matrix rows are narrowed to the connected app.

title: Four controls and marks on S4's screens have no content-matrix or control-matrix row: the sort buttons, the 'Show the other N files' disclosure, the 'Shown as' links to the findings page, and the Trace 'Kind' badge.
expected: Stage-2 brief check 4: list anything the screens show that no matrix row accounts for.
actual: Sort buttons (Item and Module on Trace, Gap and Module on Gaps, Register on Record) reorder rows by delivered key; 'Show the other 4 files' reveals held-back Sources rows; each gap carries a link to the Overview or module page it is shown on; each Trace row carries a Passage, Figure, Row or Chart badge. All four work as the code and tests describe (sorting by id and module checked ascending and descending with Enter and Space; focus moves to the first revealed file; links reach the module page); the matrix is silent on them.
suggested_change: Add matrix rows for the four, or record that they are accepted without one.
